conclusions: All eight long noisy files have conditional decoder L2 below 10%; pooled 3.7070%.
The separate p232_007 short clip has 12.2874% conditional decoder error, so below 10% is not a universal property.
None of the nine files achieves below 10% full-model waveform L2.
Conditional decoder L2 is a component diagnostic, not an alternative success claim for the end-to-end 10% target.
Exact downstream matching at the existing long-file FPGA tokens would leave 23.8749% pooled token-induced waveform error.
artifact_paths: Every files/provenance path is relative to the repository root. New same-token CPU decodes and their records are stored here; existing tracked validation artifacts are reused by SHA256. Historical original_artifact_provenance paths are informational and are never loaded by the reproducer.
